notes.title: Major Update: Herbal Medicine - v0.3.1.202508071225
notes.content: [h3][i]Greetings, lost souls![/i][/h3][p][/p][p]In this update, we wanted to focus on adjusting the way players heal.[/p][p][/p][p]Instead of relying on leveling up and hoping you get enough healing from it, we have introduced a new healing system - Healing Potions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/99152ee31faf48a74f6dd20a6cfa53fbe24b28e2.png"][/img][/p][p]Potions come in different sizes and drop from enemies, just like any other item.[/p][p]They can be common, magic, rare, and unique, but so far we haven't added any unique potions yet.[/p][p]You start with 2 potion charges, and the only way to restore these is by finding potion fountains scattered throughout Sanctora, or by visiting the shop and buying a charge there.[/p][p][/p][p]This also introduced a new major change - randomized points of interest.[/p][p]This means that chests, ritual spots, and potion fountains will now have their positions randomized throughout the world instead of always being in the fixed position like before. This introduces more variety to the run and makes planning a bit more chaotic.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Herbal Medicine (v0.3.1.202508071225) Patch notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New languages available: Portuguese (Brazil), German, Spanish, Italian, French, Turkish, and Korean![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Prophecies have their AI art replaced by real art made by real people. [/b]Not all of it is done yet, but we're slowly getting there.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Randomized points of interest[/b]: Chests and ritual spots are removed from their predefined positions. Instead, each region has a fixed number of spots that can be used to spawn a point of interest which can be one of several options: Small Chest (1 item), Medium Chest (2 items), Large Chest (3 items), Healing Fountain (+1 potion charge in exchange for gold), Ritual Monument (same as ritual spots previously, allows you to convoke the abyss).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing potions[/b] now drop the same as any other item in the game, but more scarcely.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potions[/b] provide healing on use and store up to 2 charges. Consuming the potion slows you while drinking, and the heal happens with a small delay, but causes the potion to heal you instantly + some more over the next 6 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Merchant[/b] no longer sells heals but potion charges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heal on level up[/b] still exists as a stat, but doesn't come with a predefined 20% max HP per level bonus as it previously did.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies have their behavior slightly reworked to allow for rotations even mid-attacks or between consecutive attacks. This allows them to track you better when performing combos to make stepping behind them just a bit more difficult.[/p][/*][*][p]Items now drop with more relevancy so that they don't overflow your inventory when you already have better items equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Input remapping has been reworked and works properly in the main menu and in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]The gate before Istwan's arena remains open after you've unlocked it for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Tornado, Windfury, Spark, and Thundergod's Wrath damage does damage in a wider numerical range (for example, Spark base damage changed from 13-17 to 5-25), and they do a little less damage overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Meteor now dishes out its damage over time over 2 seconds (down from 4).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug which caused the player to become stuck if trying to swap weapons while climbing ladders.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug that allowed the darkness curse limit to reach 0 and crash the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Meteor now properly shows its radius (used to be visually smaller than it actually is).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, be sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/m5rQCmHxtM" style="button"]Discord[/url] channel to stay up to date with our development and be able to give us feedback, suggest changes, or report issues.[/p]

notes.title: ♰ Major Update: The Bells Toll - v0.3.0.202506191222 ♰
notes.content: [h3][i]Greetings, lost souls! [/i][/h3][p][/p][p]It's been a couple of months since we last posted any big updates, but "The Bells Toll" should make it up for that. With this update, we focused on adding two new regions - Cathedral of Silent Oaths and The Foundry, located above the Depraved Estate of Sanctora.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/e100a6ee3ccbe39ffb735b5bad0aa97e9abc5c1f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/a6be7726e03395fa946812ff04483070573764b0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/29569ad7aa7d4831b45ec339675de2ed5eecd6d4.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]The Bells Toll (v0.3.0.202506191332) Patch notes:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Content:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New languages available: Japanese, Polish, Russian, Chinese, and Serbian (more to come)![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Two new regions: [b]Cathedral of Silent Oaths[/b] and [b]The Foundry[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Infinite reroll rework[/b]: After completing "Soldier of Light", the first skill choice allows you to pick any skill and use up all your banishes in a screen that lists all unlocked skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New skill: Ethereal Blade (Astromancer)[/b] - A buff that lasts for a short time, causing your attacks to spawn an ethereal blade to strike enemies in front of you. Has a medium cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Skill: Celestial Shard (Astromancer)[/b] - A shard bounces between all enemies, dealing magic damage to each enemy hit. After it has hit all enemies, it returns to you and grants you u barrier for each enemy hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Skill: Power Overwhelming (Astromancer)[/b] - When hitting enemies with your attacks, it increases your magic damage and slows your movement speed. When dashing, clear the buff/debuff, and leave an arcane sphere behind that shoots arcane missiles at nearby enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Unique: Sword of Ruin[/b] - Unique Two Handed Swords - a colossal two-handed sword which attacks at a constant rate, but makes your attack speed scale your physical damage instead.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Unique: Paleskin[/b] - Unique Medium Armor - upon being hit, blinds all enemies and increases dodge chance for a short duration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Unique: Warden's Guise[/b] - Unique Cloth Armor - upon being hit, triggers an arcane nova which does magic damage around you and grants a  barrier for each enemy hit (10s cooldown).[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Unique: Devourer's Maw[/b] - Unique Heavy Armor - upon being hit by direct damage, gain increased resistance and bonus attack damage of the same type as incoming damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Unique: Covetous Storm Ring[/b] - Unique Ring - all damage can now apply shock. Upon applying 6 stacks of Shock on an enemy, fire a chain lightning at that enemy and remove all Shock charges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]8 new Prophecies[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tier 4 armors, weapons, and jewelry.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]Skills/General:[/b][/p][list][*][p]All characters are un-stunnable for 4 seconds after being stunned.[/p][/*][*][p]Strength now adds 0.3 block force per point.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elemental Overload[/b] now consumes all stacks when firing a nova, and the damage of the nova is increased based on the number of stacks consumed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Killer Instinct[/b] critical damage per stack reduced from 10/15/20/25/30% to 10/12.5/15/17.5/20%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thundergod's Wrath[/b] movement speed increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Damage is greatly reduced on gear and stars.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemies:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Boss kills[/b] now guarantee [b]Unique[/b] item drops if there are any items left in the pool that haven't dropped in the run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Istwan, the Blade of Light,[/b] does less damage, has less armor and resistances, and doesn't do damage when taking off into his power move.[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies will now rotate even when attacking, making it harder to simply run behind them to avoid attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scholar Adepts[/b] will now block incoming attacks when not attacking. If they block an attack, a magic spear appears above their head. Upon blocking 3 incoming attacks, they launch their spears towards the attacker, dealing magic damage on hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]College Apprentices[/b] now use Magic Swords in addition to regular magic pebbles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Headmaster Ludwig[/b]'s spinning blades now fly in a smaller arc to his sides.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heralds'[/b] attack pattern reworked.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Nerfed wands[/b]: all wands have their attack range reduced from 10 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Most cloth armors and helmets[/b] now provide an increased maximum barrier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The upper floor of the College dormitory now acts as an arena[/b], locking you in until you defeat 3 waves of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Executioner's Cowl[/b]'s bonus critical damage no longer stacks, and its bonus is reduced from 50% to 40%, and its Strength bonus is reduced from 10-12 to 6-8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twisted Crow's Effigy[/b] bonus is halved instead of reset on damage taken.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We have decided to remove Compendium for now as we're not updating it regularly, and it doesn't make too much sense to have it until we're done with the early access content.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes / Quality of Life:[/h3][list][*][p]Changed how damage text appears so it's less jittery and a bit smaller to reduce visual noise.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced "Best Time" with "Prophecies Fulfilled" in the run end screen because "Best Time" no longer makes sense since run times dramatically change with every content addition.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now change how your cursor looks in the game - Old cursor, new brighter cursor, or the system's default cursor.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now begin your attacks when dashing/charging.[/p][/*][*][p]Ethereal bridges now hint at their location only the first time they're discovered.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Rats nest now properly resume spawning rats when disengaged and then engaged again.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug that caused the next character level to be displayed improperly in the run completed screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed golden braziers still emitting light after you've used them and reloaded the scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed ethereal bridges moving the camera when reloading the scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug that caused your game to be responsive when trying to choose a skill while none are available after getting a random skill from the shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed deadeye not firing multishots with certain weapons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug that caused inquisitors to not stay dead when revived by Istwan.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, be sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/m5rQCmHxtM" style="button"]Discord[/url] channel to stay up to date with our development and be able to give us feedback, suggest changes, or report issues.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/3290a8a26a9d47b5e85eb9c21b9db7a50b953808.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/d2df43c29ae7964b769eb9eb96c162a7c544553c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Chronicles of Heresy #5
notes.content:
[i]Greetings lost souls![/i]

It's been a little while since we released a bigger content update, but this whole time we've been working hard on the next part of the game - Cathedral of Silent Oaths and The Foundry!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/e100a6ee3ccbe39ffb735b5bad0aa97e9abc5c1f.jpg[/img]

Another big thing we've been preoccupied with is starting our collaboration with [b]Ultimate Games SA[/b]! We're thrilled to be pushing forward together to make Heretical the best version of itself. 

This partnership gives us something we’ve long needed—greater stability and confidence that Heretical will not only continue to grow, but reach full release as we envisioned it. Your support got us this far, and with this added momentum, we’re more determined than ever to see it through.

In other news, we've also decided to remove the free demo as we feel it doesn't represent the game in its brightest light. It has proven to be a major distraction for each bigger update we're working on as it's taking a lot of time to keep up to date while our team has shrunk down significantly.

Back to the main topic at hand - [b]the new update[/b]!

The major thing we've been developing is the two new regions - Cathedral of Silent Oaths and The Foundry. These two can be found adjacent to the Deprived Estate, above the high wall of Sanctora.
Regions feature 3 new boss fights, multiple new skills and uniques, as well as numerous prophecies to complete.

So, let's start one by one:

[h3]New Bosses[/h3]
There are three major bosses that you will encounter.

These new bosses have diverse mechanics and will test your skill and build even further than the previous ones. While working on the regions, we made sure to make the order in which you do these optional to allow for more planning and build diversity. Without spoiling anything, here are a few images of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/29569ad7aa7d4831b45ec339675de2ed5eecd6d4.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Skills[/h3]
Alongside everything else, we've also focused on enriching the Astromancer's skill category, adding 3 new skills: Celestial Shard, Ethereal Blade, and Power Overwhelming. Here's a glimpse of what they do:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/3290a8a26a9d47b5e85eb9c21b9db7a50b953808.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Uniques[/h3]
Also, we made sure to add several new Unique items to make the gameplay even more diverse, and here are a few examples of those:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/d2df43c29ae7964b769eb9eb96c162a7c544553c.jpg[/img]

On the note of Uniques, we've also decided to make Uniques more common by making sure that every boss killed drops a guaranteed unique item to help you solidify your build more easily and quickly.

Besides these things, we've also made sure to fix numerous issues and improve gameplay in the existing regions by introducing new shortcuts, reworking some enemies, and much more. More on that in the detailed patch notes once the update is released.

As a final note, we wanted to let you know that you can expect this new patch to drop somewhere during the first week of June.

Moving forward, we'll make sure to make these chronicles at least once a month to keep you posted on the progress and how we're doing.

notes.title: Heretical Early Access Patch Notes v0.2.9.202503171546

notes.title: Heretical Early Access Patch Notes v0.2.9.202503111355
notes.content:
[i]Greetings lost souls![/i]

New patch for Early Acces just released - v0.2.9.202503111355

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New skill: Bramble Dance (Pathfinder) - A whirl of barbs stays behind you and another one flies outwards when you attack. After a short delay, they meet in the middle, dealing physical damage to enemies they pass through and applying the bleed effect.
[*] 2 new Prophecies
[*] Soldier of Light - Istwan's Prophecy now grants an ability to reroll your first skill choice indefinitely at no costs, but no longer grants additional skill slots.
[*] Venomous Coating rework: When ready, your direct damage poisons targets. When on cooldown, there's a chance to ignore cooldown and poison anyway. For every 2000 decay damage done in the run, this skill's damage over time is increased by 1.
[*] Decay Damage now ignores barrier.
[*] Improved minion AI.
[*] King's Guard quest reworked.
[*] Fedy (Wildheart's Minion) has two skills:
[*] Demoralizing Howl which slows enemies in a large area.
[*] Soul Link: Links either Silva or the player with Fedy, transferring 50% of the damage taken by the linked target to Fedy.
[*] Silva (Wildheart's Minion) has a new skill: Primal Howl - marks enemies, granting hit points regeneration when they're slain.
[*] Added a new attack to Gorewarden Cervid.
[*] Some improvements in the Level Design of the Forsaken Settlement and Deprived Estate.
[*] Barrier now doesn't automatically scale with your hit points, but instead it's limited by max barrier stat.
[*] New stat and affix: Max Barrier - increases total barrier that you can accumulate through skills.
[*] Wraiths in Headmaster's fight now take longer to respawn.
[*] Many more balance changes.
[*] Apprentices inside college rooftop arena now spawn with a delay to give you time to react and get to a safe distance.
[*] Boulder breaker no longer shoots boulders outside of playable bounds.
[*] Reworked hotkeys for the profile selection screen to avoid accidental profile deletion.
[/list]

As always be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/m5rQCmHxtM]Discord[/url] channel to stay up to date with our development and be able to give us feedback, suggest changes, or report issues.

notes.title: Heretical Update: Celestial Weave - v0.2.9.202501211257
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/031a230ed464082d5b83c3974a10c303414abc22.jpg[/img]

[i]Greetings lost souls![/i]

After two months of hard work, we're releasing our content update called Celestial Weave!

With this update, we wanted to focus on balancing existing content while adding more progression milestones such as new Prophecies and builds to try out.

One of the bigger changes is the complete rework of the Well of Stars and its Constellations. We felt this aspect could be greatly improved to allow you to specialize in more niche and specific builds.

Celestial Weave (v0.2.9.202501211257) Patch notes:

[h3]Privacy and Data:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option in the settings and in the EULA screen to opt-out from Analytics so you're not sending any anonymous data to help improve the game.
[/list]

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Well of Stars and Constellation rework:
[*] Instead of 3 big constellations, there are now 12 smaller constellations, each specializing in different things.
[*] You begin the game with the first 4 constellations already available to allocate to (Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence and Vitality), while the rest is locked behind prophecies. Check out prophecies to figure out how to unlock the new constellations.
[*] New skill: Frost Spikes (Cryomancer) - every 4th attack sends out a series of frost spikes in front of you, dealing physical and frost damage to enemies they hit.
[*] New Skill: Hunter's Mark (Pathfinder) - marks an enemy, reducing its defences and making it more prone to bleeding. Killing a marked enemy reduces the cooldown of the skill and grants bonus XP and Gold.
[*] New Unique: Whirlwind Edge - two handed axe which allows you to whirlwind and deal damage around you instead of attacking.
[*] New Unique: Executioner's Cowl - Unique Helmet - bleed and execute synergy.
[*] New Unique: Devourer's Skull - magic offhand - increases item quality and quantity, every time you discard a magic, rare, set or unique item, it gains power. When channeled, does area physical damage and reduces armor and resistances of nearby enemies.
[*] Added a few Training Dummies and a shortcut in the Sanctuary of the Forlorn once you cleanse the region.
[*] 14 new Prophecies
[*] Added new Jewelry: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence and Vitality amulets. These drop in the same loot table as Claw Amulets, and can all become Curse Eater/Twisted Crow Effigy.
[/list]

[h3]Reworks:[/h3]

[b]Characters:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wildheart rework: Verdal no longer provides bonus on level 2, instead you begin with two canine companions - Fedy and Silva. Level 5 and up you get verdals as before. Your companions have a revive timer and run alongside you attacking enemies.
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*] Frozen Armor rework: Procs on both block and damage taken, shooting an ice spear at the attacker and grants small amount of barrier.
[*] Howling Ice rework: now shoots ice spears in a medium area, instead of firing frost novas.
[*] Soul Harvest rework: Every few secinds, Spectral scythe spins around you, dealing magic and decay damage and granting you some barrier.
[*] Death's Gamble: Renamed to Killer Instinct and moved from Trickster to Pathfinder skills.
[/list]
[b]Uniques:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stormcaller Blade rework: Grants +1 cyclone strike, +1 windfury and +1 windseeker skills. Gains increased lightning damage for each level of every windseeker skill you have.
[*] Heartseeker Bow rework: No longer has chaining projectiles. No longer provides bonuses to Elemental Damage. New unique ability: Whenever you land a critical hit with this bow, gain +5 attack damage and +10% critical strike damage with attacks against that target.
[/list]
[b]Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blocking no longer requires you to be frontally facing enemies. In other works, blocking now absorbs damage regardless of where it's coming from.
[*] Dashing grants you phasing, allowing you to dash through enemies to avoid getting stuck in corners or tight corridors. Also, while dashing, you no longer take damage from traps.
[*] Poise Damage no longer scales with critical strike damage. Instead, crits now deal up to 150% of the base poise damage.
[*] You can no longer attack targets through walls with AOE Skills and Melee Attacks. This might need some deeper testing.
[*] Starting Darkness Curse limit is 50 and Black Dawn, Grim Harvest and Black Gates now longer increase it. Instead, they each provide +item quantity, +item quality, +gold find / darkness level.
[*] Bleed Rework: Bleed now procs on any physical damage, and does 60% of damage dealt over 4 seconds as physical damage over time. This can be triggered by chance to bleed stat, and its damage can be improved by increased bleed damage.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]

[b]Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies' darkness scaling per darkness rebalanced:
[*] Damage reduced from 25% to 10%.
[*] Hit points increased from 20% to 25%.
[*] Enemies can now be immune to certain status effects, for example:
[*] Decaying Hound - immune to Slow
[*] Wraith - immune to Bleed, Chilled
[*] Gargoyle - immune to Poison, Bleed, Burning
[*] And many more...
[*] Increased enemy variety in all areas.
[*] Alpha Rats regenerate Hit Points.
[*] Deprived's Heal cooldown reduced from 3 to 1.5 seconds.
[*] Elite Enemies now gain new stats and immunities.
[*] Executors' 3 hit combo range decreased from 8 to 4.
[*] Istwan's Storm Ascendant skill cooldown increased from 10 to 20 seconds.
[*] Self inflicted damage (such as Plague Carrier's immolate) no longer counts towards prophecy completion.
[/list]
[b]Items:[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed one handed melee weapons: swords allow you to move faster and deal more damage, axes deal significantly more damage and maces are a bit more powerful.
[*] New item Affix: Chance to bleed
[*] New item Affix: Barrier on Kill
[*] New item Affix: Increased Gold Gain - increases amount of gold you gain.
[*] Many items have their stat scaling changed or reduced to make room for new content coming down the line.
[*] Shop Enchantment Affixes buffed - Increased Proc Chance, Poisonous Attacks, Heal per Level and Dash Cooldown.
[*] Twisted Crow Effigy bonus per kill reduced from 2% to 1% per kill.
[*] Curse Eater now lowers Darkness Curse limit instead of raising it.
[*] Hit Points Affixes on items increased so it's on pair with Vitality bonuses gained by items.
[*] Added bonus Intelligence to Gore Eye unique wand.
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*] Burning Blood now triggers even when you take pure barrier damage and not lose HP.
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*] Base Attributes grant less bonuses initially.
[*] Fall Damage penalty reduced
[*] Lost and Found Prophecy - Item Quantity bonus reduced from 25% to 10%.
[/list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Frozen Armor, Procupine, Shield Bash, Retribution now count as Reflected damage.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added "freecam" console command which lets you detach from the character and move around freely.
[*] Affixes on items are now always shown with "+" or "-" in front of the value to have a standardized way of showing stats.
[*] New option in settings: Show enemy status effects - this will show enemy debuffs and buffs underneath their health bars.
[*] Magic and Rare items are no longer named with convoluted names, but rather just marked by color to increase readability and make localization easier.
[*] New sounds for Rat King's fight.
[*] Improved some 3D visuals and textures across the map.
[*] You can press LeftControl + F3 to toggle UI. This can be done via console command "togglehud" as well.
[*] Falling now reduces horizontal velocity rapidly, making it harder to fall to your death unintentionally.
[*] Added railing to the catwalk in Forsake Settlement to prevent accidental falling on an already narrow path.
[*] Shop now more clearly separates New Items from Item Enchants.
[*] Bonuses to XP gained are now properly taken into account when showing XP gained on kill.
[*] Enemy bonuses and player bonuses from darkness level now color coded for readability.
[*] Players are now invulnerable during Dialogues and Rituals.
[*] When you're offered a single item for an empty slot, you can click on the item itself to keep it.
[*] Moved some camera triggers' angles so it's easier to reach certain places on the map.
[*] Some level design changes to make traversal in certain areas easier and less buggy.
[*] Character descriptions for playable characters in Compendium and Main Menu are no longer segmented and locked behind number of runs.
[*] Changed visuals for Ketha's Cache to be easier to spot.
[*] Dialogue screen shows text faster and now scales vertically so that all text can fit inside of it.
[*] Prophet no longer spams dialogue lines when you've already talked to her.
[*] Death, Victory and Run History screens visually updated.
[*] Death and Victory screens now have damage detail tabs which show what weapon did the most damage as well as exact damage types done by skills/wepaons.
[*] Improved VFX for Unique Item drops.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed some hover texts overlapping each other in Character Screen inside Pause Menu.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed scroll speed of various screens
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed a bug which caused enemies to not drop loot and XP if frozen.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed stats in character sheet not being visible on aspect ratios narrower than 16:9.
[*] Bug Fix: Blind now properly lasts 6 seconds (instead of forever).
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed rebinding issue which caused rebinding on gamepad to not work when pressing LB or RB ingame.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed a bug which prevented you from increasing ruin in the run you unlock it in.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed a bug which caused Gore Eye to show different damage than what it was dealing to enemies.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed a bug which caused Tier 3 enemies to drop Tier 2 Crow's Amulets.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed a bug which caused the game to resume while choosing rewards if you pressed ESC while looking at Stats. ESC now returns you to the rewards screen instead.
[*] Bug Fix: When skills are removed via shop, getting the same skill afterwards is reset back to level 1.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed being able to use offhand relics while attacking.
[*] Bug Fix: Plagued Rat Horror's selection circle disappears when it dies.
[/list]

[h3]Third Person Mode:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved background and made some ceilings opaque.
[*] Pressing left control unlocks your mouse so you can hover skills.
[*] Improved character rotation to better follow where you're aiming at.
[*] Firing projectiles without having a target selected now aims the projectile at the point of the crosshair.
[/list]

As always be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/m5rQCmHxtM]Discord[/url] channel to stay up to date with our development and be able to give us feedback, suggest changes, or report issues.

notes.title: Darkness Rework - Heretical Early Access Patch Notes v0.2.6.202411082226
notes.content:
[b]Darkness Mechanic Reworked:[/b]

[list]
[*] No longer will the Abyss consume you when your Darkness reaches it's Darkness Limit.
[*] Instead, whenever you reach your Darkness limit, enemies in the world become more difficult (like before), and you gain 1 Devotee's Burden which you can spend on Rituals.
[*] Rituals offer a chance to gain bonuses similar to previous item corruptions, but applied to your character instead. These are called Abyssal Blessings. In order to complete a ritual, you must also take upon yourself a temporary debuff, or Gold/HP loss.
[*] Abyssal Blessings have upsides and downsides, like item curses, and the detrimental effects can be cleared by killing great enemies.
[*] Killing Great Enemies will still clear the negative effects of the Blessing, but if there's no blessing to cleanse, you'll gain a Luminous Fragment which can be used in further rituals to automatically gain an Abyssal Blessing without detriments.
[/list]

notes.title: Heretical is now in Early Access !!!
notes.content:
[i]Greetings lost souls![/i]

We are happy to announce that Heretical is now available in [b]Early Access[/b]!

For us at Three Swords Studio, this is an enormous milestone, something we've been striving towards for the past 16 months. And now it's here.

So, to keep it short, this is what you get by buying the Early Access version the game:
[list]
[*] 5 Regions
[*] 8 Playable Characters
[*] 7 Bosses
[*] 69 Prophecies
[*] 30 Skills
[*] 20+ Unique Items
[*] 30+ hours of playtime to complete all the Prophecies
[/list]

Of course, purchasing Heretical for $14.99 while in Early Access grants you access to all future updates. This includes the Full Release version as well, where you won't have to pay the full price of the game ($24.99).

At this point, we believe Heretical will be in Early Access until some point of the second half of 2025, but more info will be available as we approach that timeframe.

Considering that Early Access represents some 50% of the game's content, our focus in the following months will be on adding new regions, playable characters, skills, prophecies, bosses, enemies, weapons/gear, unique items, etc.

We would like to use this opportunity to send a [b]GIGANTIC THANK YOU[/b] to all the players on the Heretical Discord for helping us get here. We're deeply humbled with all your feedback and support.

Three Swords Studio

notes.title: Chronicles of Heresy #1
notes.content:
[i]Greetings lost souls![/i]

We're writing this as our first official Devlog which we will be posting weekly to keep you all up to speed on how the development of Heretical is coming along.

In case you've missed it, here's our gameplay trailer showing some mechanics that we have in the game:

[previewyoutube=FfHNRjX9Wkk;full][/previewyoutube]

After visiting a conference in Croatia, we felt encouraged to open our development to the community and invite you all to participate by joining our official [url=https://discord.gg/A2bYFF7gdS]Discord [/url]channel.

We began working on this game as a prequel to our other project, but it quickly grew into a beast of a project.

We started having too much fun with it and how, after a year of dedicated development we're aiming to release a [b]free playable demo[/b] during June 2024. The exact date is yet to be announced but we're aiming for the first half of the month.

Here's a snippet of our character selection in which you can see Harald, the starting class of Heretical, as well as two other classes that you'd be able to unlock while playing the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/0f4928c40b616c2175a772d2582b6c87cd388b88.jpg[/img]

We intend to keep the demo updated so that it features all the mechanics and balance changes present in the final product, and you'll be able to transfer your save files from the demo to the main game.

We also plan to release the game in early access by the end of the summer, but we'll be posting more updates regarding that when the time comes.

Let's talk a bit about our game design philosophy and the design choices we've made so far.

[h3]Art Style[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/5cb7577b8cd4c709b6a4c3a0607ffb10b6142263.jpg[/img]
We opted for a stylized, simplistic, yet dark art style because we wanted to showcase the city of Sanctora in all of its glory while keeping the performance of the game in check. Currently, the game runs smoothly even on Steam Deck, gliding at 60 FPS while having the whole world of Heretical loaded in at all times.
The city of Sanctora is a dark and troubled place, plagued by a curse cast upon its citizens by a ruthless leader called Abidan. Death, disease, and corruption have spread deep into its foundations. The city is in a dire state and it weeps for cleansing of the curse.

[h3]Loop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/c26cad040eb8a7fa8bb3d53bef984fe5fb694c13.jpg[/img]
Once you choose your character, you progress through the city of Sanctora, killing enemies and gaining power through leveling up and picking up loot until you're inevitably killed or consumed by the curse.
However, in each run, you unlock more items, skills, or even character classes by completing quests that we call Prophecies, making our subsequent playthroughs more powerful and potent. The game has enough prophecies to keep you coming back for hours while hiding powerful upgrades throughout our intricate level design.

[h3]Loot[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/3eaf449895e411a570893bf4381e52b20c9e5a9c.jpg[/img]
Whenever you kill an enemy or open a chest, there's a chance that an important piece of loot might drop. Heretical doesn't have an inventory, instead you always choose to keep only one of the two items - the one you were already using, or the new one that just dropped.
This way, you can watch your character grow in power without having to worry about inventory management or having 5 swords to choose from.
Any item you choose to discard is converted into coins that you can use to buy things from the merchant, so nothing is wasted!
We decided to handle items in this way so that you wouldn't spend too much time looking at menus, but focus on the action instead.

[h3]Skills[/h3]
With skills, we took an already tested approach, similar to what's seen in other games where you're offered a few skills from the skill pool and pick one. Once you fill out your skill slots you can upgrade skills when you level up instead of getting new ones. This way, you can't 100% control what you get, but with rerolls and banishes you can narrow it down to the skills you care about and want to create your build around.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/ff19e3b72221abc1528277904d665d9ff75cb95c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Progression[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923362/d4f6e2b67dc1f5772885a192161227d70a16e43c.jpg[/img]
Prophecies allow you to unlock new skills, skill slots, unique items, character classes, powerups, and much more. Each prophecy requires you to focus on a specific thing in the game making your character class, skills, and items crucial to completing it.

Phew, that's a long read! We'll reveal more updates in future devlogs, but in the meantime, you can follow our [url=https://twitter.com/HereticalRPG]Twitter [/url]profile for updates and keep an eye out for more announcements here.

[i][b]Frenchtoastfella - Three Swords Studio[/b][/i]
